promises.speaker: Salil Taneja, Chairman & Whole-Time Director
promises.quote: we see some uptick this year

promises.source: Transcript of 11th AGM of TAAL Enterprises Ltd, 2025-08-26, taaltech.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/25.-11th-AGM-Transcript.pdf (answer to shareholder questions on order book and pipeline)
promises.outcome: FY26 consolidated revenue from operations Rs 19,742.92 lakh vs FY25 Rs 18,514.02 lakh: +6.6%. Uptick delivered.

promises.note: Speaker also said the running business would be about flat on the prior year before the uptick [para]; graded against the uptick. Same AGM restated the margin band (see 10th AGM item); not a new promise.

promises.quote: a 25 to 30% EBITDA margin is something that we, we are quite confident that we can achieve

promises.note: Earliest statement of the band: 9th AGM (2023-09-26) gave no figure ('hope that we will be able to smooth them out'); 8th AGM (2022-09-28) gave none.
